verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs state that sandboxes resume from standby in under 25ms, even after weeks of scale-to-zero. They also say new sandboxes deploy from images "in seconds", which fits the sub-second-to-few-second startup the story asks for. missing for 10: a precise documented latency figure for true cold creation (as opposed to resume from standby), and independent or hands-on benchmarks corroborating the vendor claims.
